name: Yamaha XV750 Virago
engine: 748 cc air-cooled V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive
intro: Yamaha's first V-twin cruiser. Dependable, with one famous weak spot: the starter gears.

add.title: Check the starter gears
add.instructions: If the starter grinds or spins without turning the engine, check the starter idler gear and its tension clip. Yamaha's fix is a new clip, part 904-68291-06-00.
add.reason: Worn starter gears are the Virago's best-known fault.
add.src: Canada Moto Guide Virago starter notes

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Starter grinding
known.what: The starter drive gears wear and grind. The starter motor itself is usually fine.
